subject.title: feat(slack): support Enterprise Grid org installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this opt-in Slack Enterprise Grid org-install mode in the bundled Slack plugin now, including its new config/API surfaces and fail-closed V1 delivery limits?
rationale: The change alters Slack workspace authorization boundaries and adds public configuration plus plugin adapter hooks, and the PR carries a protected maintainer label, so automation should not decide the product/security boundary.

options.title: Review as Enterprise V1 candidate
options.body: Accept the direction only after docs-map cleanup, live org-install proof, and focused maintainer review of workspace isolation and unsupported delivery paths.

options.title: Narrow before accepting
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a smaller design or partial PR if the new adapter/config surface is too broad for this release.

options.title: Defer org installs
options.body: Keep the current per-workspace Slack account model if maintainers do not want bundled Enterprise Grid support yet.

recommendation.title: Review as Enterprise V1 candidate
recommendation.body: Accept the direction only after docs-map cleanup, live org-install proof, and focused maintainer review of workspace isolation and unsupported delivery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest visible recent history in the Slack/config area touched by this PR.
